title: Timeline Item and Date Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims
Timelines
vis-timeline
JSON
Date Handling
description: A vis-timeline MicroSim that places eight fictional course-schedule events from the template's JSON event format, shows each event's JSON beside its rendered item, and lets learners toggle the month off-by-one bug, filter by group, and edit an event's month to watch it move.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Timeline event items, JSON dates and grouping
learningObjectives: The learner will use the JSON event format to place events on a timeline and will identify how month numbering and group values change what is displayed.

dependencies: vis-timeline 7.7.3 standalone UMD and CSS (jsDelivr CDN)

accessibility.notes: All controls are native buttons, a checkbox and a text field (Enter submits); the detail panel and caption are aria-live regions; navigation buttons have aria-labels

dataFiles: data.json (eight fictional course-schedule events in the timeline template format)

controls.label: All / Planning / Teaching / Assessment
controls.purpose: Clear the dataset and re-add only events whose group matches

controls.label: Pan left, Pan right, Zoom in, Zoom out, Fit All
controls.purpose: Navigate the timeline (wheel zoom and drag are disabled in the embed)

controls.label: Show month numbering bug
controls.purpose: Rebuild dates without subtracting 1 from the month

controls.label: Event month (1-12)
controls.purpose: New month value for the selected event

controls.label: Update
controls.purpose: Write the month into the event's JSON and redraw the item

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked examples with a deliberate bug to diagnose
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Data-to-display explorer (JSON beside rendered item) with an edit field
keyQuestions: Why does the script subtract 1 from the month?
Which events move when the subtraction is removed, and why do year-only events stay?
How does the group value change the color and the filter result?
commonMisconceptions: JavaScript Date months run 1-12 like calendar months (they run 0-11)
A filter button matches group names loosely (it compares exactly)
assessmentOpportunities: Moving an event to a named target month with the edit field
Writing the JSON and the new Date() call for a new event
